name: Neville C Kohl
source:
[i]"Discipline yourselves! Shun desire and preserve purity!"[/i]

The principal of St. John's Seminary. An exceptionally brilliant scholar who was appointed principal at a young age. He's terrifyingly strict and doesn't overlook a breach in discipline. Being a fierce advocate in corporal punishment, he punishes students for even the slightest mistake with spankings and confinement in the reflection room, and is considered a fearsome figure. He’s especially obsessive about abstinence, going to great lengths to make sure the students maintain their chastity and purity.

[Translated from the [url=https://pilslash.jp/product/shingaku/]official website[/url]].
